note: The navmesh polylines of the Arlokk terrace walks in Zul'Gurub leg 4 (map 309): one route per pair of consecutive move rows, sampled every yard between the rows' points. TestZulGurubArlokkTerraceRouteClearOfLaterPacks always checks its clearance rule against these and fails when a recomputation differs by more than 1 yd at a point. Rewrite with: go test -run TestZulGurubArlokkTerraceRouteClearOfLaterPacks -update-routes ./tools/dungeongen/
